description:
Dated changelog of the Vibe Shipped directory: apps built with AI, AI build tools, Agent Toolbox entries and agent harnesses that were added or updated, newest first.
Use when: the user asks what changed recently in AI coding tools, or you want to refresh earlier results since a date.
Do not use for: keyword search (search_apps) or full lists (list_tools, list_harnesses).
Returns: items[] with type, slug, name, change (added|updated), date (YYYY-MM-DD), url to cite, source, date_basis.
Limits: since is inclusive; type takes app, tool, agent-tool, harness (comma-separated); limit 1-500, default 50.
Example: {"since":"2026-10-15","type":"harness,agent-tool","limit":20}

since.description: Only changes on or after this date, format YYYY-MM-DD.

type.description: Entry type filter: app, tool, agent-tool or harness. Comma-separate several, e.g. "harness,agent-tool".

name: whats_new
title: What's new on Vibe Shipped
